based_on: Byte-precise mutation of fixtures/external/pytorch.softmax-ce.batched.golden.jsonl. G-S1 residual-false-PASS fixture: closes the gap where Rule 14 inspected only the top-level (batch-reduced) forward/loss and never the per-sample forward/loss of a batched observer receipt.

mutation.note: Exactly ONE per_sample forward value is forged (+0.05). per_sample.s1.inputs/targets are untouched, and the reduced gradient / update / weight_after / parameters_after are LEFT engine-consistent (the engine recomputes them from per_sample[*].inputs, not from the forged per_sample.forward, so they still match). Before this fixture's defense, Rule 14 only compared the TOP-LEVEL reduced forward/loss and skipped per_sample entirely, so this forge produced a clean PASS (ok:true) — a residual false-PASS for the inverted threat model. Rule 14 now mirrors the importer's stricter per-sample check (import-observer.ts): it recomputes per-sample state via runBatchedGeneralStep and compares per_sample[*].forward.{net,out} and per_sample[*].loss.{per_output,total}, so the engine recompute of s1.forward.h1.out (0.554779235) disagrees with the forged 0.604779235 and Rule 14 fires.

reconciliation_check_targeted_first: Rule 14: Engine-recompute differential (per-sample) — per_sample.s1.forward.h1.out claim does not match the engine-recomputed per-sample forward value.
non_vacuity: Removing the per-sample comparison block added to checkRule14EngineRecomputeDifferential makes the reconciler return ok:true on this fixture (RED). The reduced fields stay engine-consistent, so no other rule catches the forged per-sample forward value — the per-sample loop is the sole defense.
purpose: G-S1 anti-circularity fixture. Pressure-tests that Rule 14's engine-recompute differential generalizes to PER-SAMPLE forward/loss for batched observer receipts, not just the batch-reduced top-level fields.
v0_9_note: v0.9 ships batched SGD softmax+CE observer-mode ingestion. The per-sample differential mirrors the importer's load-bearing per-sample check; this fixture proves reconcileReceipt() does not silently skip it.
